limitations: Conditions use existing tire, suspension and wear physics. No equipment gates, artificial grip bonuses, or new damage multipliers.
Recommendations are shop-available parts; this tool does not grant inventory or change purchase prices.
Cooling, brake fade and skid-plate-only boss checks are not implemented. These stages use tire/suspension challenges that the current simulation supports.
Geometry-based duration estimates predate these conditions. Full player laps are needed for final difficulty and timing balance.

stages.name: Mount Washington Auto Road
stages.briefing: Snow tires recommended. Packed snow covers the climb from the start; slow down before the hairpins. You can attempt this with any equipment.

stages.name: Laurel Highlands Scenic Byway
stages.briefing: Rally suspension recommended. Long frost-damaged sections interrupt the pavement. Stock suspension can get through at a slower pace.

stages.name: Ohio River Crossing
stages.briefing: Rain tires recommended. A winter thaw has soaked the valley road. Leave braking room and ease off through wet corners.

stages.name: Ozark Backroads
stages.briefing: Rally tires recommended. Exposed dirt dominates this abandoned highway, with loose gravel sections between the wooded bends. Reuse your rally setup and keep the throttle measured.

stages.name: Data Center City
stages.briefing: A balanced road setup works here. Industrial straights and bends are interrupted by short rubble crossings. Brake before the rubble; a rally build trades asphalt grip for easier crossings.

stages.name: Historic Route 66
stages.briefing: Tarmac tires recommended. Exposed dry pavement rewards road grip at speed. Cooling and gearing can help a powerful build, but are not entry requirements.

stages.name: Pikes Peak Highway
stages.briefing: Road tires recommended for this mostly dry climb. Use the gearbox through the uphill hairpins, then slow well down for the short snow-covered summit approach. Snow tires sacrifice grip over most of the route.

stages.name: Moki Dugway
stages.briefing: Off-road suspension and rally tires recommended. Long eroded stretches demand suspension travel. A road setup must crawl through the roughest sections.

stages.name: Oak Creek Canyon
stages.briefing: A balanced road setup works here. Dry canyon bends alternate with shaded wet stretches left by the thaw. Adjust braking at each surface change; rain tires trade some dry grip for wet confidence.

stages.name: Angeles Crest Highway
stages.briefing: Tarmac tires and road suspension recommended. Dry technical corners reward a road setup; snow and off-road tires give up substantial asphalt grip.
